title: CREATE TABLE & Storage Parameters
description: Create robust relational tables, configure fillfactor, unlogged tables, and storage options.

data.text: The **`CREATE TABLE`** statement defines the physical schema of an entity. Beyond column definitions and constraints, PostgreSQL supports specialized table storage configurations like `fillfactor` and `UNLOGGED` tables.

An **UNLOGGED table** does not write modifications to the Write-Ahead Log (WAL). This makes inserts and updates 2x-5x faster, at the cost of being truncated automatically if the database crashes. They are ideal for transient sessions, intermediate ETL steps, and cache layers.

data.content: Setting fillfactor to 80% to leave room for HOT updates.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: `CREATE TABLE` establishes columns, types, and constraints.
`UNLOGGED` tables bypass WAL generation for ultra-fast transient operations.
`fillfactor` leaves empty space in data pages to facilitate in-place HOT updates.
